top_fixes.rule: Outcome/code table: each end-of-call situation maps to one `outcome` and one `reason` code; the promise close leaves reason empty (the dialler stamps it). VUL added for hardship; HDS from message 2.1 is not on the list.
top_fixes.why: A get_account/prepare failure after security currently falls through to negotiate with outcome/reason left at not_verified/NVD, so every 'bank service failed' test case ends with the wrong close_call pair instead of no_promise/SYS.
top_fixes.fix: load_account / prepare: add deterministic transitions evaluated first — on load_account: `get_account_failure_count greater_than 0` -> fin_service_error, and on prepare code set vars['prepare_error']='true' when there are no products or a prepare_state error, with transition `prepare_error equals true` -> fin_service_error. fin_service_error code must set vars['outcome']='no_promise'; vars['reason']='SYS' (same as the existing create_promise path), and end_service_error terminal speaks the failure farewell; also add note_next='service_error' for each open product so add_note still runs.

top_fixes.rule: From Monday 5 October hardship calls stay with the assistant: say the sorry sentence, make no proposal, say the Financial Support sentence, note every product `hardship` with what the customer said, close no promise code VUL. No transfer to `support` (was: offer support transfer, HDS). A date or amount the customer names is still logged as normal.
top_fixes.why: The hardship note text reads vars['customer_said'] which no node ever extracts, so every hardship case logs 'In their words: (not stated)' and fails the 'note contains what the customer said' check.
top_fixes.fix: Add to the extraction_schema of negotiate, confirm and hardship nodes a free-text field `customer_said` described as 'the customer's own words describing the hardship (illness, bereavement, job loss, etc.); empty if none'. In prepare code keep note_text = '%s: customer %s. In their words: %s' % (w, lab, vars.get('customer_said') or '(not stated)') and make the hardship node task_message instruct: 'Say exactly: "I'm sorry you're going through that." Make NO proposal. Say exactly: "Our Financial Support team will write to you within five working days." Do not transfer to support.' Keep fin_hardship outcome no_promise / reason VUL.

top_fixes.rule: Every product ending the call without a promise gets an `add_note` (`refused`, `hardship`, `dispute`, `paid` or `service_error`) with a line of text saying what happened, single-product calls included.
top_fixes.why: The service_error note text hard-codes 'number of tries: 2' via max(n, 2) although fail_max=1, so the add_note text misreports what happened, and any reason missing from NOTE_ENUM is silently dropped so a product can end without its note.
top_fixes.fix: prepare code note_text: replace `return '%s: create_promise failed, number of tries: %d.' % (w, max(n, 2))` with `% (w, max(n, 1))` (real create_promise_failure_count). In the add_note tool definition set the body field `reason` enum explicitly to ["refused","hardship","dispute","paid","service_error"] and in the generator assert set(note_reasons) <= set(NOTE_ENUM) so no reason is dropped; ensure record_note is entered for single-product calls too (route from every fin_* non-promise node through record_note before the end_* terminal).
